spans.s:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (बुक्कति बुक्कयति-ते)
1 To bark.
2 To speak.
r. 10th cl.
To give pain.

subst. mfn. (-क्कः-क्का-क्की-क्कं)
The heart.
m. (-क्कः)
A goat.
E.
बुक्क to bark, &c., aff. अच्; also बुक्कन् mn. (-क्का-क्क) also बुक्क.

mfn. (-क्कः-क्का-क्कं)
The heart: also बुक्क; also with a final न्, बूक्कन्^1
mfn. (-क्कः-क्का-क्क)
also बृक्क.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

n. (-नं)
Barking, (as of a dog.)
E.
बुक्क to bark, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-सं)
The heart.
E.
बुक्क the heart, अग्र principal, मांस flesh.

m. (-रः)
The roar or barking of a lion.
E.
बुक्क to bark, आर aff.; the lion of Hindustan barks much like a dog.
